name: Art Domain (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
You have pledged yourself to the creation, display of art.

Granted Powers
Artist’s Touch (Su)

You can cast mending at will, using your cleric level as the caster level to repair damaged art or tools. You can, with a melee touch, grant a creature a bonus on their next Artistry, Craft, Perform, or art-related Profession check equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum +1).

Enthralling Art (Su)

At 8th level, you may display or perform a piece of art (no skill check required) and infuse it with a modicum of divine energy to make it a enthralling to witness. This acts as the fascinate bardic performance using your cleric level as your effective bard level. The fascination may be maintained for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level plus your Charisma modifier. Additionally, you may use the suggestion bardic performance a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. This also uses your cleric level as your effective bardic level. If you have levels in a class that provide these bardic performances, your levels stack when using these abilities. This domain ability does not stack with any archetype that provides bardic performances (like the evangelist).

Domain Spells: 1st–play instrument, 2nd–minor image, 3rd–major image, 4th-majestic image, 5th–joyful rapture, 6th–irresistible dance, 7th–waves of ecstasy, 8th–scintillating pattern, 9th-resplendent mansion
